response.goal: We get partnership requests by email. We want each new email in our "Partners" Gmail label summarized by an AI model and added to Airtable: sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary and a priority flag. A person on our team reviews anything marked low confidence.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirement review for Gmail integration and Airtable schema
Develop script to read emails from the Partners Gmail label and parse fields
Integrate AI model to generate summaries, request types, and priority flags
Store processed lead data into Airtable and handle low-confidence review flows

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Gmail Reader and AI Integration
milestones.deliverable: Working script that reads labeled emails and generates AI summaries and priority flags

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Airtable Sync and Review Workflow
milestones.deliverable: Fully deployed automation writing data to Airtable with low-confidence routing

risks.risk: Budget is specified as an hourly rate without a fixed total or estimated hours.
risks.mitigation: Establish a weekly hour cap and provide regular progress reports to stay within expected bounds.

risks.risk: Potential discrepancies between requested OpenAI API and prior Gemini experience.
risks.mitigation: Utilize adaptable Python code structures that can interface seamlessly with either LLM API.

questions: What specific fields are required in the Airtable base schema?
What criteria defines a low-confidence classification that requires human review?
assumptions: The client has existing Gmail and Airtable accounts with necessary API access permissions.
The hourly rate of $35–$55 per hour applies to all development and testing time.
